The '''''Nebula Stalker''''' was a famous [[ghost ship]]. According to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] tale, the ''Nebula Stalker'' crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
